To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we develop the first CCN-enabled webserver (CCNxTomcat) that can natively support CCNx-based web applications, and it outperforms existing HTTP/CCNX proxy solutions in throughput by 58% and 3X respectively, in terms of single request and 1000 concurrent request.
we have developed the first practical CCNx-enabled web server, which can support the existing HTTP-based web applications and also natively support CCNx-based web applications.
CCNxTomcast can be used as a practical web server to support CCN-based browser/server applications, and ccncache can be used to efficiently support caching for CCN-based web servers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fundamental issue of how to support the mainstream web applications on CCN, which is critical for a large-scale deployment of CCN.
the design and development of the first CCNx-enabled web server, which is a key to CCN-based web services.
the design and implementation of a practical CCN-enabled server, which can be a key component of a future CCN network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have designed and implemented the first web server for CCN, and it can support legacy web applications as well as new CCN-based web services.
CCNxTomcast can effectively support CCN-based browser/server web applications.
CCNxTomCat is a practical and efficient CCN-enabled web application server, which is able to support the dominant browser/server web architecture and the emerging CCN network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide an efficient solution to support the existing web applications on CCN, and also enable a smooth evolution from the current IP-based web applications to future CCN-based ones.
CCNxTomcast is an effective and practical solution for the deployment of CCN-based web services, and can help accelerate the adoption of the new CCN architecture.
we have developed the first practical CCNx-enabled web server, which is able to natively support both legacy web applications and CCN-based web services.

a native CCN web server can be built on the top of the existing web server architecture.
the design of CCNxTomcast provides a new perspective on how to build a practical CCN-based web server, which is a key to support CCN-based applications.
